script:
In physics, string theory is a theoretical framework in which the point-like particles of particle physics are replaced by one-dimensional objects called strings.
That is not a guess – it is what the science actually says.
String theory describes how these strings move through space and interact with each other by vibrations.
On distance scales larger than the string scale, a string acts like a particle, with its mass, charge, and other properties determined by the vibrational state of the string.
And that is the real story of String Theory Explained – What is The True Nature of Reality?.
